answer: Falcon patrols sweep the tundra of new identities: each agent must lock a refundable stake that vests only after it completes verified work across three unrelated dune markets. A farm cloning identities pays the full stake per alias and waits out the same vesting clock, so its capital sits idle while honest agents earn. If an alias is caught sharing a funding trail, its stake is slashed and its market history is burned, forcing the operator to rebuild reputation from zero.
